title: Canonical exact derived tower evaluation interchange
statement:
For categories $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$, put $J=\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}}$ and $\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A)=\operatorname{Fun}(J,\mathcal A)$, using strict towers [def-weil-inverse-system]. For a functor $F:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$, write $F^{\mathrm{Tow}}$ for postcomposition by $F$ and $e_n^{\mathcal A}$ for evaluation at positive level $n$ (encoded by $\operatorname{op}(n-1)$). Package pointwise preservation of finite limits, respectively finite colimits [def-galois-exact-functor], as the canonical preservation structures on $F^{\mathrm{Tow}}$ whenever $\mathcal B$ has those finite limits, respectively finite colimits, and $F$ preserves them. Now let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian [def-sp-abelian], let $F$ be additive and exact, and choose unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of $\mathcal A,\mathcal B,\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A),\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal B)$, with independent morphism universe bounds. For an exact additive functor $H$, let $D(H)$ be its canonical localization from termwise action on complexes, and let $c(H,K):D(H\circ K)\xrightarrow{\sim}D(H)\circ D(K)$ denote the canonical composition comparison (here composition is written in Lean order: first $H$, then $K$). Define the exact derived evaluation interchange by the composite
$$D(F^{\mathrm{Tow}})\circ D(e_n^{\mathcal A})\xrightarrow{c(F^{\mathrm{Tow}},e_n^{\mathcal A})^{-1}}D(F^{\mathrm{Tow}}\circ e_n^{\mathcal A})=D(e_n^{\mathcal B}\circ F)\xrightarrow{c(e_n^{\mathcal B},F)}D(e_n^{\mathcal B})\circ D(F).$$
The middle equality is the strict ordinary evaluation identity, so this definition involves no choice of a derived right-adjoint comparison or normalization theorem.

lean.statement:
def towerDerivedEvaluationInterchange
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} [Category.{vA} A] [Category.{vB} B]
    [Abelian A] [Abelian B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{wB} B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wTA} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A)] [HasDerivedCategory.{wTB} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ B)]
    (F : B ⥤ A) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (n : ℕᵒᵖ) :
    ((Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ B A).obj F).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        ((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ A).obj n).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      ((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ B).obj n).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ F.mapDerivedCategory
